info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Information Provider Operation Status-spec
info.description: The Information Provider Operation Status API allows users to retrieve the current operational status of information providers within the banking sector. This endpoint provides critical insights into the availability and performance of various market data providers. It is particularly useful for developers integrating real-time financial data into applications, ensuring that they can monitor and respond to any outages or disruptions. Typical consumers include financial institutions, app developers, and data analysts seeking to maximize the reliability of their data sources.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of an information provider operation.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to check the current status of a specified information provider operation within the market data system. It provides insights into the health and activity of the operation, helping users make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the status of the information provider operation. It is expected to contain all relevant parameters to identify the specific operation whose status is being queried.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current status of the information provider operation.

ListInformationProviderOperationStatusRe.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation on the status of information provider operations in the market data resource.
